## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Ruff, version/configuration checks and applicable tests pass.
- [ ] Tests exercise real behavior, including failure and boundary cases.
- [ ] Coverage exclusions, skipped tests and weaker assertions were not added to hide gaps.
- [ ] Identity isolation, fail-soft hooks, non-blocking writes and admin/runtime DDL separation remain intact.
- [ ] New dependencies have upper bounds; public changes and migrations are documented.
